nom: Paula's Choice Pro-Collagen Peptide Plumping Moisturizer

avis.titre: Lightweight but Deeply Hydrating — My Nighttime Staple
avis.texte: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I use it every night before bed, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and gel-like, and it sinks into the skin quickly without feeling greasy or heavy like so many other moisturizers I’ve tried. It’s perfect for nights when I want hydration without that thick, sticky feeling. Despite how light it feels, it truly hydrates. I wake up with my skin feeling baby soft, smooth, and visibly refreshed. After using it consistently, I also noticed my skin looking more plump and bouncy, which honestly surprised me. It layers well, doesn’t clog my pores, and works especially well after serums or treatments. I like using this at night when my skin just needs something simple and reliable. The only downside is that if you have very dry skin, this might not be enough on its own—but for normal, combination, or oily skin, it’s perfect. Best for: normal, combination, or oily skin and anyone who prefers lightweight hydration Not ideal if: you need a thick, heavy cream for very dry skin If you’re deciding between this and a heavier cream, this is the better option if you want hydration without feeling greasy. Update after continued use: still one of my go-to nighttime moisturizers—my skin consistently feels soft and balanced when I use it. A little goes a long way, so the value for the price is excellent. I genuinely swear by this moisturizer—it delivers real results and never disappoints.

I absolutely love this moisturizer! It feels lightweight but still very nourishing. My skin drinks it up without leaving any greasy residue, and I’ve noticed a real difference in the plumpness and smoothness of my skin after a few weeks of use. The peptides and collagen-boosting ingredients really do make my skin look firmer and more refreshed. The pump packaging is also a big plus—it keeps the product clean and makes it easy to dispense just the right amount. A little goes a long way, so even though it’s a bit pricey, it lasts longer than I expected. If you’re looking for something to hydrate and help with fine lines while giving your skin a healthy glow, this is worth every penny!

avis.titre: Lightweight, Hydrating & Leaves My Skin So Soft
avis.texte: I’ve been really happy with this moisturizer! It feels lightweight but still very hydrating, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and comfortable without being greasy. I love that it has a nice plumping effect and works well under makeup or on its own. My skin looks a little more refreshed and healthy when I use it consistently. Definitely a product I’d repurchase!

avis.titre: Excellent moisturizer that isn't heavy and leaves your skin feeling plump & fresh
avis.texte: I've never used a gel moisturizer before, but this feels fabulous on my skin. It doesn't leave a greasy feeling at all, but soaks right in and makes you feel so hydrated and fresh.

I love the Pro-Collagen Peptide Plumping Face Moisturizer. It is not oily and absorbs into my skin nicely. There is no fragrance. I gave it 3 starts because if you use one pump of this moisturizer twice a day, it barely lasts one month. It is way to expensive for the amount you receive and it's impossible to tell when you are close to the bottom.

I really like Paula’s Choice Pro-Collagen pump face moisturizer. My skin feels smooth. The moisturizer is not greasy and it feels very light weight on my face. The pump works well, no issues. I will definitely buy this product again.

avis.titre: Love for make up prep & night routine
avis.texte: Love this moisturizer. Velvet feel after working into the skin. I use w/ my faux tanner on wrist hands feet ankles neck knees to help even out difficult area while keeping them moisturized - baby powder absorbs moisture but helps even out those areas as well (cheaper option).

I love it. It’s expensive so I would only get it while it’s on sale but it makes my skin super smooth. I’m also acne prone and found that this product doesn’t aggravate my acne at all. It also mixes well with my makeup (I’ve found some cheap moisturizers make my makeup peel). Definitely recommend (but when on sale).

Very pleasantly surprised with this moisturiser . It absorbed really quickly , I usually have issues with things absorbing in to my skin and it takes forever - but not this one. Once absorbed it felt really nice , my skin was soft and felt hydrated too. No fragrance , which was also nice. Very lightweight , as they say in the description , I would absolutely agree with that claim. So far so good , I am really enjoying using this moisturiser . Hope to see results in skin quality in the near future but for now I can say it is doing exactly what I would hope for for a moisturiser. Would recommend

I love this brand, always top quality. The moisturiser is in between a gel and a cream, pale pink in colour and is absorbed quickly. Leaves my skin feeling so smooth. It is super lightweight and non-greasy. No reaction at all, in fact, my skin just drinks it up and looks 'glowy'. Nice to use in the mornings, before applying make up. I can't say it makes me look years younger but I do feel that it makes my skin a little plumper and less tired looking. Well worth the price tag if you are wanting to 'up' your skin care routine.

avis.titre: Hydrating and really nice to put on.
avis.texte: Super hydrating for night time. It doesn't get absorbed as easily as some other products, so I haven't yet used this under my make-up during the day. This isn't an issue for night time though. Not irritating - I don't have sensitive skin, but do often find that some products just don't mix well with others and this irritates my skin. This seemed to pair well with a couple of the serums that I use. No smell or colour which is great! Definitely worth considering if you are in the market for a peptide product.

avis.titre: Lightweight Yet Super Hydrating - Worth a Go!
avis.texte: If you're after a moisturiser that hydrates without feeling heavy, Paula’s Choice Pro-Collagen Peptide is the one. It absorbs quickly and leaves your skin glowing and refreshed ✅ Pros: - Lightweight, fast-absorbing gel-cream texture - Non-fragrance formula, ideal for sensitive skin - Leaves skin feeling smooth, plump and hydrated - Foundation-friendly, no pilling - Contains peptides for improved skin elasticity ❌ Cons: - Silicone presence (dimethicone) may not be your thing - Not ideal for those seeking a dewy, fresh moisturiser feel

avis.titre: Lightweight & Fast-Absorbing Moisturiser – Great for Under Makeup!
avis.texte: This moisturiser has a gel-like texture with no scent, and it absorbs quickly into the skin. I find it lightweight and think it could even work as a primer under makeup. While it does contain dimethicone (a type of silicone), which some people avoid, I personally don’t mind it since it doesn’t cause breakouts for me. It also doesn’t leave a heavy or filmy feeling on my skin, which is a big plus. I also appreciate the hygienic pump packaging - definitely a great touch!

I got this when it was on sale to try. Hands down one of the best moisturizers I have ever used. My skin looks supple and no irritation as I am a sensitive girly in my 30’s, improved my skin texture too! Highly recommend!

I really like this cream! The texture is soft and pleasant, not heavy at all. It has a nice light pink color and goes on the skin very smoothly. The scent is neutral, which I appreciate. I have combination skin, and this cream moisturizes perfectly. It leaves my skin feeling soft and velvety all day, without any oily feeling. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Needs to be layered with other products
avis.texte: Its gives hydration for only an hour definitely needs to be layered with other products. I have combination skin it felt dry even in the t zone. Not sure if i actually see any difference after using it for a few weeks, definitely no change after one use i like hot it leaves smooth finish.
Es todo lo que promete, un hidratante ligera que hace que mi piel despierte por las mañanas, muy fresca y adoro el aplicado.
The texture is nice and light. The product is great if having a no makeup day and gives a dewy glow. However with oily skin it isn’t ideal for makeup days.

avis.titre: great plumper for eye and mouth area
avis.texte: fantastic plumping product! my middle aged face needs plumped and its always thirsty. this product has almost no smell which I like. its a thick smooth gel like consistency. my skin soaked it up. I read that using this in the areas that need plumped works better than using it as an all over face cream. I placed some under my crepe skin eyes and my mouth. this plumped my lips up too very well. It's almost like clinique moisture surge as it plumps fast but this one includes collagen! The product arrived doubled sealed. You definitely need to wash it off before applying makeup as it stays sticky.

avis.titre: Really good moisturizer. Helps with my dry face!
avis.texte: This is a really nice moisturizer! It leaves my face feeling smooth and soft! It doesn’t have a strong smell or much of a smell at all. It is a miss between cream and gel like texture. It’s not a lotion like texture. It is easy to apply and you don’t need much to put to apply it all over your face. It seems to last all day. I have been using it in the morning and at night and at night before bed. My face tends to be more on the dry side but this has definitely helped.

First off, super impressed with the packaging that insured this to come to me without being damaged or leaking or being in a whole mess when I got here this brand is always good at this. Very appreciated. Now as far as this product, it goes on like a dream. It does not leave my skin super oily looking, but it does give it a nice glow I feel like it really deeply moisturize my skin as far as being any more plump. I have been using it for about a week now, and I would say that it is doing a good job at making my life lines, a little less noticeable while I don’t have too many wrinkles I do appreciate that. I am someone who likes a nice light sent to my facial products. This does not have a scent, but I am not bothered by that so those who like unscented would really appreciate this product..

This brand is one of my favorites but I hadn’t yet tried this moisturizer. It is a gel-cream, and it goes on rather thick. If you have super dry skin I think you’ll like it. To me, it is a bit too heavy on my face. Texture-wise it feels good applying it. I also put my sunscreen over it and it didn’t look good together. I’ll likely use this only at night.

I wasn't expecting to like this as much as I do, but it's quickly become one of my favorite skincare products. The texture is lightweight and it sinks in without leaving any residue at all—no greasy film or tacky feeling. It just makes my skin feel soft, smooth, and somehow bouncier within minutes. I’ve noticed it gives an instant plumping effect, and over time I’m hoping the collagen helps keep my skin firm and hydrated. Since collagen supports elasticity and helps reduce the look of fine lines, this cream feels like a win in both the short and long term. I'm really glad I tried it out.

This moisturizer is very luxurious. The velvety texture helps it glide onto your skin. It creates a nice moisture barrier as it absorbs and once absorbed it leaves your skin smooth like a light primer. I really enjoyed wearing it at night and waking up to supple hydrated skin. It also works great on dry skin. I have combination skin and this moisturizer did not make my skin oily.

avis.titre: Great Addition to Your Skin Routine
avis.texte: This Brand Name Product makes skin feel good. Skin looks nourished and glows nicely after use. It's kind of pricey but it does not take a lot of product to be effective.

Paula’s Choice Pro-Collagen Peptide Plumping Moisturizer is lightweight but very moisturizing. This gel works hard to hydrate your skin and leaves it plump and hydrated. My face and neck feel so smooth after using. This is virtually scent free. I’m very happy with how my skin feels after using and I think it’s a great value. You don’t need a ton of this product to have your skin looking happy, hydrated and healthy.

I've been using this collagen peptide moisturizer just over a week now and liking it so far. I have pretty sensitive skin and haven't experienced any issues with breakouts. The texture has a velvety feel when applying and it is thick but not heavy. I use two pumps each application and it goes on smooth, does not feel greasy, and soaks in quickly with no residue, and doesn't have an overpowering scent. So far so good!
